_about: Icons for tool cards on the Tools & Pipelines page. 'families' names each icon (label is used as alt text: '<label> logo'); 'pipelines' maps a tool's Zenodo id to a family. To add an icon: put a PNG in app/static/img/tools/, add a family, and map ids to it. Tools not mapped to a family get the 'default' icon (the CONP generic tool icon); remove 'default' to fall back to the old grey cog. Generated by map_tool_icons.py from the live tool list, then reviewed by hand.

default.label: Tool
default.source: CONP-designed, derived from the CONP logo's leaf-neuron soma (light-grey gear with the soma, dark grey with a small red nucleus, at the hub)
default.why: Placeholder for tools without their own logo; approved by Patrick 2026-10-14
